lines.en: I scurry along with my nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的刺在草里蹭得沙沙响。
lines.en: My quills rasp through the grass.
I walk along a tree root, sniffing.
I take a step, then pause.

lines.zh: 草丛比我高，我只能听着走。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; I go by sound.

lines.zh: 我从不走远，只绕着一小块地。
lines.en: I never roam far; I circle one small patch.
My short legs don't carry me fast.
I smell pumpkin.
I push through a pile of fallen leaves.
Dry leaves crackle under me.
I keep to the shade of the bush.
Quills raised, I walk on slowly.

lines.zh: 我在草原上走得很小心。
lines.en: I move carefully across the plain.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱开一小堆土。
lines.en: I root a little mound of soil open.

lines.zh: 树影移动了，我换个方向。
lines.en: The tree shadow moved; I change direction.
Any noise makes me duck.
I stop and pull myself in tight.

lines.zh: 我在闻腐叶下有没有虫。
lines.en: I sniff under the rotting leaves for bugs.

lines.zh: 我把软肚子藏进刺球里。
lines.en: I hide my soft belly inside a ball of quills.
The wind through my quills tickles a little.
I'm sniffing for worms underground.
My eyes are small and bright.
I tuck my forepaws under my belly.
I stay still, passing for a spiky ball.
A bird calls once, far off.
I sneeze, very small.
My quills stand up one by one.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时更安全。
lines.en: I wait for dark; it's safer then.
You want to pet me? It'll hurt.
These quills aren't decoration.
Your hand is too big.
Don't reach down from above.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手里有南瓜子。
lines.en: I smell pumpkin seeds in your hand.

lines.zh: 你站在我的落叶堆上了。
lines.en: You're standing on my leaf pile.
I half curl up, then relax.
You wouldn't flip me over, would you?

lines.zh: 我走路声音很大，你听见了。
lines.en: You heard me coming; I'm loud.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只看到你的靴子。
lines.en: I look up and only see your boots.
Are you laughing at all my quills?
I edge back into the grass.
I curl tighter than before.
I squeak, very softly.
A few quills are bent.
I tip over and struggle upright.
It hurts enough to sting my nose.
I burrow into the grass pile.

lines.zh: 我不动，让它以为我死了。
lines.en: I stay still and let it think I'm dead.
I shake and my quills rise again.
I can still walk with this.
Being flipped over scares me more.
Pumpkin seeds — my favorite.
Insect meat will do; I'll eat it.
Put it on the ground and I'll come.
Let me sniff it once more.
Step back; don't watch me eat.

lines.zh: 南瓜子的香气，我一闻就懂。
lines.en: One sniff and I know pumpkin seed.
I flatten my quills a little.
You're bribing me. I know.

lines.zh: 我可以吃，但不会跟你走。
lines.en: I'll eat, but I won't follow you.
A little more; I'm not done.
I hold it and nibble.
Hold still; I haven't decided.
You touched my quills.
One bump and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住刺，我吱了一声。
lines.en: Your heel pins my quills and I squeak.
I roll half a meter away.
We collide and I bounce off.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我的路堵死了。
lines.en: Your boot has blocked my path.
My quills catch your trouser leg.
I back into the grass.
That hurt you too, didn't it.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，慢慢爬起来。
lines.en: I roll over and slowly right myself.
I've found another one.

lines.zh: 我们说不上话，就一起找吃的。
lines.en: We can't talk, so we forage together.
It's a bit rounder than me.
We press close; our quills don't prick.
We turn over the fallen leaves together.
It goes first; I follow.
We line the nest thicker.
Its nose touches mine.

lines.zh: 两只刺猬挨着，刺都放平。
lines.en: Two hedgehogs press close, quills laid flat.
By morning it's gone.
I root up a small piece.
I carry it in my teeth and drag.
This pricks; I'll be careful.
I hide it in the nest.
A seed; just right.
I push it the whole way.
I sniff what's on the ground first.

lines.zh: 我把南瓜子含在嘴里，没咽。
lines.en: I hold the pumpkin seed in my mouth without swallowing.

lines.zh: 这块树皮拖不动，我松了嘴。
lines.en: This bark won't drag; I let it go.
I pick up a strip of bark.
Something's moving; I raise my quills.
I curl up and wait.
That sound is much too near.
I don't run; I prick.

lines.zh: 有脚步靠近，我竖起了刺。
lines.en: Footsteps approach; my quills rise.
If it reaches, it'll hurt.
I fix my eyes on that direction.
I half-curl, quill tips pointing out.
The shadow is coming over.
I make no sound and don't move.
Dare it touch this ball?
Let me count its legs first.
I hold this pose.
It circles; I turn with it.
I stay curled, quills outward.
The closer it comes, the tighter I curl.
I'm waiting for it to reach.
My breathing is shallow.
I stay low, no soft part showing.
Its steps keep circling me.
I inch toward the grass.
The moment it stops, I roll away.
I can hold this a long while.
Every quill points its way.

lines.zh: 我猛地一缩，扎进它手里。
lines.en: I snap shut and drive my quills into its hand.
It touched me first.
I butt with my back.
There's blood on its fingers.
I bite once, very small.
I roll into its boot and spike it.
Every quill on me stands up.
It lets go and I drop.
It should remember that one.
I curl back up and wait for the next.
I come out from under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我从落叶下露出半张脸。
lines.en: Half my face shows from under the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，刺上挂着叶。
lines.en: I root out of the soil with leaves stuck to my quills.

lines.zh: 这片南瓜地，够我住一阵。
lines.en: This pumpkin patch will do me for a while.

lines.zh: 我把自己团起来，先看看。
lines.en: I ball up and take a look first.
My quills aren't fully up yet.
The sun has just gone behind the trees.
I set off along a tree root.
The meadow gains one more rustle.
I smell this ground for the first time.

lines.zh: 火一碰刺，我立刻缩成球。
lines.en: Fire touches my quills and I snap into a ball.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滚下来，摔得晕。
lines.en: I roll off a rock and land dizzy.

lines.zh: 水浸进刺里，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water soaks into my quills and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 炸起的土块压在我背上。
lines.en: Clods of dirt land on my back.
An arrow splits a few of my quills.
Light holds me still and my quills go limp.

lines.zh: 找不到虫，我越来越没力。
lines.en: No bugs to find; I'm weakening.

lines.zh: 雷声把我震得缩了一天。
lines.en: The thunder keeps me curled up all day.

lines.zh: 这里没有草可钻，我悬着。
lines.en: No grass to burrow into; I'm adrift.
